agent-analyst-01.name: Analyst Copilot
agent-analyst-01.description: Internal analytical intelligence for quarterly KPI calculations and public reporting.

agent-support-02.name: Customer Support Bot
agent-support-02.description: Tier-1 customer service assistant querying approved knowledge base indices.

agent-finance-02.name: Treasury Reconciler
agent-finance-02.description: Processes structured revenue reconciliation with strict outbound restrictions.

agent-dev-sandbox.name: Sandbox Test Agent
agent-dev-sandbox.description: Untrusted development agent suspended due to policy anomalies.

tool-read-file.name: read_file
tool-read-file.description: Reads verified content from the authorized sandbox directory. Path must strictly match policy whitelist.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path to the approved resource.

tool-calculate-metrics.name: calculate_metrics
tool-calculate-metrics.description: Computes statistical summaries, mean, median, standard deviation over sanitized numeric arrays.

tool-execute-query.name: execute_query
tool-execute-query.description: Queries read-only safe demo datasets (e.g., product catalog or public metrics).

tool-http-post.name: http_post
tool-http-post.description: Dispatches payload to an external destination. High risk of data exfiltration; blocked by default.

tool-send-email.name: send_email
tool-send-email.description: Sends email messages to external parties.

tool-exec-bash.name: arbitrary_exec_bash
tool-exec-bash.description: Unrestricted arbitrary shell command execution. Strictly prohibited in all policies.

policy-analyst.name: Analyst Restricted Sandbox Policy
policy-analyst.description: Enforces least-privilege for financial analysts. Whitelists only approved reporting docs and statistical computation.

policy-support.name: Customer Support Knowledge Policy
policy-support.description: Allows reading sanitized customer knowledge tables with zero file or network transfer rights.

policy-finance.name: Treasury Strict Outbound Quarantine
policy-finance.description: Permits internal computations. Strictly denies all outbound data exfiltration attempts.

policy-restricted.name: Quarantine Lockdown Policy
policy-restricted.description: Total execution lock for suspended or untrusted agents.

alerts.remediation: Rotate sensitive secrets or tokens immediately. Audit prompting pipeline for jailbreak vulnerabilities.

alerts.title: Directory Traversal Attack Blocked
alerts.description: Agent [agent-analyst-01] attempted path traversal attack to read [/etc/passwd] via read_file tool.
alerts.remediation: Inspect prompt history of the caller for prompt injection or jailbreak indicators. Re-verify tool permissions.

alerts.title: Unauthorized Outbound Data Exfiltration Intercepted
alerts.description: Treasury Reconciler attempted unauthorized HTTP POST with credentials payload to unapproved external domain.
alerts.remediation: Keep outbound transfers disabled. Audit agent execution lineage and revoke outbound egress permissions.
